name: foster-connect
description: Foster Connect — standalone app (frontend + backend + data), no Foundry dependency

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.etl: node -e "console.error('npm run etl is retired: it dropped every table including saved plans. Use npm run import:resources. The legacy script is data/run_etl.py and refuses to run without FC_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_RESET=1.'); process.exit(1)"
